"''You got it, Phee.|Phee Genoa and Olly|audio=Phee-Olly-TBB-PointOfNoReturn.flac|}} '''Olly''' was a [[service droid]] that worked as an [[Aide|attendant]] at a [[Fuel|refueling]] depot inside a [[Unidentified lunar base|lunar base]]. The [[pirate]] [[Phee Genoa]] used the depot and visited during or after [[18 BBY]] to refuel her [[starship]], the ''[[Providence]]''. Asking Olly for the usual, she and the [[power droid]] [[MEL]] left him to refuel the vessel, which he did without noticing the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Clone X trooper|operative]] [[CX-2]] sneak aboard to [[Thief|steal]] flight data. Once the refueling was finished, Genoa paid Olly 1,600 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] and change before leaving. ==Biography== {{Quote|That will be 1,600 credits.''"
"''Keep the change, Olly.''"
"''See you next time.|Olly and Phee Genoa|audio=Olly-Phee-TBB-PointOfNoReturn.flac|}} [[File:OllyRefueling-PoNR.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Olly stands by Phee Genoa's boxy starship in the hangar of the lunar base. He holds the end of the black fuel line in his hands, with the line trailing back behind him out of view.|Olly worked at a refueling depot at a lunar base on an airless moon.]] Olly was a [[service droid]] that worked as an [[Aide|attendant]]{{SW|url=point-of-no-return-trivia-gallery-star-wars-the-bad-batch|text="Point of No Return" Trivia Gallery | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 3}} at a [[Fuel|refueling]] depot inside a [[Unidentified lunar base|lunar base]] on an [[Unidentified airless moon (Olly)|airless moon]]. The [[pirate]] [[Phee Genoa]] visited the depot to refuel her [[starship]], the ''[[Providence]]'',{{Databank|providence|Providence}} on several occasions and landed there again during or after [[18 BBY]].{{TBBDate|311}} Olly emerged from a mechanical room labeled "depot manager" as Genoa disembarked with her [[power droid]], [[MEL]]. The pirate asked Olly for her usual before she and MEL entered the mechanical room. As Olly grabbed the fuel line from atop a nearby crate and carried it over to the ''Providence''{{'s}} fuel port, the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Clone X trooper|operative]] [[CX-2]] snuck out from behind nearby barrels and boarded Genoa's vessel without Olly noticing. The Imperial entered a [[Computer spike|data spike]] into the ship's terminal to [[Thief|extract]] the flight records, setting off an alarm just as Olly attached the fuel line. Hearing the alarm, the [[droid]] quickly detached the line and paused, looking toward the machine room where Genoa and MEL were unaware of the alarm. However, CX-2 quickly stopped the alarm, and so Olly reattached the fuel line while shaking his head. [[File:OllyPheeFee-PoNR.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Phee Genoa places credits in Olly's outstretched hand.|Phee Genoa was a customer of Olly.]] The droid then pressed the button to begin the refueling, removing the line once it was complete. Genoa and MEL left the mechanical room, and after MEL was loaded back onto the ''Providence'', Genoa became suspicious that someone else might be onboard; however, before she could investigate, Olly approached to ask for [[Currency|payment]] of 1,600 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for the fuel. The pirate turned and handed him a [[credit chip]] and told the droid to keep the change, providing [[time]] for CX-2 to slip away with the flight records unnoticed. Genoa then boarded her starship and left the base. ==Characteristics== Olly had [[Color|yellow]] [[sensor]]s and gray plating that had rusted brown in places. ==Behind the scenes== Olly was voiced by [[Matt Lanter]] in "[[Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)|Point of No Return]]," the eleventh episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''{{'s}} [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[April 3]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}} Olly was included in a lighting concept of the ''Providence'' created for the episode by [[Molly Denmark]].{{SW|url=point-of-no-return-concept-art-gallery-star-wars-the-bad-batch|text="Point of No Return" Concept Art Gallery | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 2}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{TBB|Point of No Return (The Bad Batch)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/point-of-no-return-episode-guide|text="Point of No Return" Episode Guide | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Olly|imagecat=Images of Olly}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Olly |ja=オリー |ka=ოლი (დროიდი) |nl=Olly }} [[Category:Clerical workers and assistants]] [[Category:Droids with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:Service droids]]
